message: The 'dynamic' keyword cannot be used in the local variable '{0}' because it is initialized with a target-typed expression (such as 'default' or 'null'). Initialize the variable with an expression of type 'dynamic', for example 'meta.Default( type )'.
rationale: The advice to use an explicit cast does not work: a cast to 'dynamic' reports LAMA0250 (TemplateAnnotator.VisitCastExpression), and a cast to any other type makes the initializer non-dynamic, which reports LAMA0251 (TemplateAnnotator.VisitVariableDeclaration).
